content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with the [product_name] program. When I try to upload an image in the Graph Library section, a pop-up message appears: "WARNING: Operation failed, maybe access denied, please run this application as an administrator and try again." I'm using Windows 7 Enterprise, logged in as an administrator, and the program is installed under the same user profile. My Java installation is up to date. Regardless of whether I try to upload bmp, png, or gif files, the same problem occurs. What might be causing this?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Have you enabled the "Run this program as administrator" option in the Compatibility tab within the properties of the [product_name] program shortcut?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is repeatedly encountering an access denied error when uploading images to the Graph Library in the [product_name] software. Despite running Windows with administrative privileges and updating Java, the application requests administrator rights and fails to complete the upload, preventing image import functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to upload images to the Graph Library within [product_name] without encountering access issues, especially when operating with administrator privileges.
